measured: adsp-running pass (present), amp-channels pass (present), amp-volume-0x4c pass (present), amp-volume-0x4d pass (present), default-output pass (present), sound-card pass (present)
notes: Stereo, both speakers, verified by ear on 2026-11-09 through PipeWire (left-only tone from the top speaker, right-only from the bottom). Needs two fixes not yet upstream: the tas2562 amplifier driver set 32-bit I2S slots on a link clocked for 16-bit, so the right channel fell outside the frame (kernel patch on linux-phone-oco/linux branch fix/tas2562-i2s-slot-length); and the packaged UCM profile is mono with no amplifier channel setup (stereo profile in surya-lab ucm/). Also needs the ADSP sensors service off (adsp-sensor-crash-loop). Both fixes are installed on the test phone, over package files a system update would replace. Measured 2026-11-11 with a microphone placed at the bottom: the right channel is the bottom speaker (7 dB louder there).
The headset jack's detector is present. Sound through it needs a person and a pair of headphones: a witnessed test, not done yet.

The microphones go through the WCD9375 codec. In a test kernel (2026-11-11) the codec now comes up and the sound card is made with it, after correcting how two SoundWire pins are muxed. Recording through it is not yet shown.

The camera pipeline and its three control buses work; the phone's description lists no image sensor, which alone is why the cameras are dark. The vendor's kernel gives the wiring of seven sensor slots and names no model. Next: power a slot and ask the chip what it is (surya-lab, research/cameras.md).

notes: Joins a network, holds an address, and its gateway answers - checked after every start. Speed and the 5 GHz band are not measured.
The adapter is powered and hears nearby devices (five on 2026-11-11) - checked after every start. Pairing, and sound over Bluetooth, have not been tried.
The controller is seen by the kernel. No tool on the phone reads a tag yet.
No fingerprint reader is exposed by the kernel.
No motion, light or proximity sensor is exposed to the system. The sensor hub's service is masked on purpose: with it running, the audio processor crashed at every suspend.
